name: drivaer_settings
description: Shapes meshed with the settings of the DrivAer Case 2a mesh of issue #71 (no merging of small cut cells, no exact feature cut, one thin-wall split). With them the thin-wall junction split of 6d0975a raised the faces with an adjacent volume ratio below 0.05 on thin_walls from 446 to 794, as it raised those below 0.01 on DrivAer from 17 to 57; with the default settings both versions give nearly the same counts.
